title: Mission settlement body
description: The verifier settles a mission (register row DK1240; spec-delta S1612). `verified` true: the whole pool is paid to the recorded contributors by their units (largest remainder, ties by DID order, so every credit is paid and a contributor with no recorded units gets nothing); at least one contribution must be recorded (mission_no_contribution). `verified` false: each funder gets back what it put in. Once (mission_settled). Signed by the verifier (mission_settle_wrong_issuer). Chain: none (prev is null).
